# GGUF loader provenance

This source is from [city96/ComfyUI-GGUF](https://github.com/city96/ComfyUI-GGUF)
commit `6ea2651e7df66d7585f6ffee804b20e92fb38b8a`.

The app imports its diffusion loader inside a private worker. It does not
launch the ComfyUI interface or require a user-installed ComfyUI folder.
The upstream Apache-2.0 license is retained in `LICENSE`.
